theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_cit_approxTangent_of_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → M' ⊆ M → x ∉ closure (M \ M') → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q
